name: Verified Memory
description: Local read-only search over checksum-verified, optionally signed and dated Data & Lore packs.

packPath.description: Absolute path to a pack; omitted uses the bundled fictional sample.

trustedKeys.description: Public keys you trust to sign packs, one per entry: name ssh-ed25519 AAAA… [comment].

trustedFingerprints.description: Recommended. Pinned signer fingerprints, one per entry, as ssh-keygen -l prints them: SHA256:…. If set, a pack must be signed by one of these keys, whatever trustedKeys says.

revokedKeys.description: Revoked key fingerprints, one per entry: SHA256:…. A pack signed by one is always refused, even if pinned or trusted.

minSequence.description: Refuse any pack whose signed PACK.json sequence is missing or lower than this, so an older pack cannot be served in place of a newer one. Implies requireSignature.

strict.description: Refuse any pack that is not signed by one of trustedKeys and fresh (PACK.json present and not expired). Default false: unsigned, stale and undated packs load and are reported.

requireSignature.description: Refuse any pack that is not signed by one of trustedKeys; freshness is reported but not enforced. Default false.
